# declared loss

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:declaredLoss`](gmeow-declaredLoss.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/declaredLoss>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A loss that this notation system incurs when rendering canonical frame-relative content (e.g. quantization to 12-EDO, dropping microtiming).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile`](../classes/gmeow-NotationProjectionProfile.md) -> [`gmeow:ProjectionLoss`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionLoss.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:declaredLoss`](gmeow-declaredLoss.md) from [`gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile`](../classes/gmeow-NotationProjectionProfile.md) to [`gmeow:ProjectionLoss`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionLoss.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile`](../classes/gmeow-NotationProjectionProfile.md), [`gmeow:ProjectionLoss`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionLoss.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a projection profile to declare a kind of information the notation drops or approximates when rendering canonical content — the explicit ledger entry that makes the projection's lossiness queryable rather than silent.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for a parameter the notation carries faithfully (that is [`gmeow:representableParameter`](gmeow-representableParameter.md)) and avoid declaring a loss without pointing its [`gmeow:accountsForParameter`](gmeow-accountsForParameter.md) at the parameter it omits.

### How to use

- Attach each [`gmeow:ProjectionLoss`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionLoss.md) to the profile via [`gmeow:declaredLoss`](gmeow-declaredLoss.md) and link the loss to the omitted parameter with [`gmeow:accountsForParameter`](gmeow-accountsForParameter.md) so the completeness gate can reconcile it.

### Examples

- ex:staffProfile [`gmeow:declaredLoss`](gmeow-declaredLoss.md) ex:lossMicrotiming.
